description:
Define the contract for how generated mockup images travel from swarm-manager decisions to ecosystem-manager when handing off a new scenario. Without this contract locked, decision-image-handoff-propagation cannot ship — it currently says 'resolve image_url values into persistent references' without specifying the shape.

Must resolve: (1) does the handoff manifest carry image URLs, base64 data URIs, or file copies into the scenario directory? (2) where in the scenario directory are images placed (docs/mockups/? .vrooli/mockups/?)? (3) how are images referenced from PRD.md / requirements docs that the scenario authors generate from? (4) backward-compat for handoffs without images.

Output: schema doc + update to decision-image-handoff-propagation acceptance criteria. Coordinate with ecosystem-manager team if any consumer-side change is needed.

Why now: Same failure mode as brand-manager rollout — planning context didn't reach the scenario. Lock the contract before the propagation item executes. Surfaced during 2026-04-25 vision-walk audit.
name: decision-image-handoff-manifest-schema
title: Specify image-data shape in ecosystem-manager handoff manifest
